text:
I have returned by the grassless path.

I go to the river in search of my shadow.

What solitude sealed by cold moon.

What solitude of water without red sirens.

What solitude of acid pines, wandering...

I go to gather up my eyes

abandoned on the shore.

translation.title: Absence of the Lover
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the moon-sealed solitude and the abandoned eyes on the riverbank.
